gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-telex: Telex is curvy and unclamped, never fussy. Beneath Bruno Ace, whose ruled line has no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye, a long passage of sans text glides along without effort.

gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tirra: Bruno Ace draws a marker-like constant line, one character per beat, with counters left open to the outside. Tirra's round forms, like open parentheses, make a longer passage easy going.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-titillium-web: Ruler-straight and loose-jointed, Bruno Ace lets every letter linger in its own beat. Titillium Web follows with stroke ends set far apart, so a long run of text feels open and easygoing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tomorrow: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace looks like bent tubing, made to announce rather than explain. Tomorrow keeps its cupped, open bowls for the quieter work of carrying a paragraph in plain sans.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-trispace: Distinctive, like thin steel rod bent into letters. Bruno Ace takes the spotlight, while Trispace spreads out sparse, widely set sans letters whose curves open outward, giving the page room to breathe.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Distinctive and a bit showy. Bruno Ace is happiest making a big, ruler-drawn statement, whereas Tsukimi Rounded does its best work in quiet sans-serif text, with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tuffy: Drawn with a ruler and linked up at the edges, Bruno Ace has a lingering, one-character-per-beat stride. Tuffy's pencil-even sans strokes would sit nicely a few sizes down.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-urbanist: That constant-width line, drawn as if by ruler, gives Bruno Ace its unmistakable look. Urbanist's broad-nibbed sans strokes ease the page back down.

gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-vazirmatn: Thin joins no thinner than the stems give Bruno Ace its ruler-drawn, lingering look. Vazirmatn's wide-open sans-serif s keeps going without tightening, so paragraphs feel unhurried.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-wix-madefor-display: Distinctive and a bit showy, Bruno Ace draws every line like it was traced along a ruler. Wix Madefor Display, a plain sans with gently flared curve ends, sits beneath it and softens the whole page without competing.
